# utilisio

> Free browser-based toolkit — 25+ tools for developers, designers and everyday users.
> Most tools run entirely in your browser with no file upload required.
> No account, no signup, no tracking beyond an optional GA4 consent banner.

## Tool categories

### File tools
- Image Converter — convert between JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF with optional resize and quality control
- PDF Converter — export PDF pages to PNG/JPG or convert to DOCX for Word editing
- Audio Converter — convert between MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC and OGG via FFmpeg WebAssembly
- Video Converter — re-encode video or extract audio tracks via FFmpeg WebAssembly
- PDF Merge — combine multiple PDFs locally, drag to reorder before merging

### Developer tools
- JSON Formatter — format, validate and minify JSON with error line numbers
- UUID Generator — generate v1, v4 and v7 UUIDs in batch
- Base64 Encoder — encode text or binary files to Base64, decode back
- QR Code Generator — generate QR codes as SVG or PNG, works offline
- Hash Generator — compute MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 fingerprints for text or files
- Regex Tester — test JavaScript regex patterns with real-time match highlighting
- Cron Expression Generator — explain or build cron expressions field by field
- JWT Generator — sign HS256 JWT tokens locally, secret key never leaves browser
- Markdown Table — build Markdown tables visually, copy the pipe syntax
- TOML ↔ JSON — convert between TOML and JSON using the full TOML 1.0 spec
- HTTP Headers Checker — grade security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options) A–F

### Text tools
- Case Converter — switch between UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case
- Word Counter — real-time word, character and sentence count with reading time estimate
- URL Encoder / Decoder — percent-encode or decode URLs and individual components
- HTML Entity Encoder — escape and unescape HTML characters
- Remove Line Breaks — clean up hard-wrapped text from PDFs and email clients
- Text Reverser — flip characters, words or lines with full Unicode support
- Readability Score — Flesch-Kincaid and Gunning Fog index for EN and FR text

### Design tools
- Palette Generator — generate complementary, triadic or analogous color palettes
- Gradient Generator — design CSS linear-gradient or radial-gradient visually
- Password Generator — cryptographically secure passwords via Web Crypto API

### SEO and marketing tools
- Meta Tag Preview — simulate Google, Facebook and Twitter/X card rendering for any URL
- SEO Analyzer — on-page SEO scoring: title, meta description, headings, word count, alt attributes
- UTM Builder — build UTM-tagged campaign URLs locally, no external service
- IP Address Lookup — country, region, ISP, ASN and timezone for any IPv4 or IPv6 address

## Privacy

Most tools run locally in your browser — your files and inputs never leave your device.
Three tools use a server-side proxy to fetch external data: IP Lookup, Meta Preview and SEO Analyzer.
Inputs are not stored. Standard HTTP access logs (IP, timestamp) are retained ~30 days for security.
